entities.summary: Leander Adrian Paes is an Indian former professional tennis player. He is regarded as one of the greatest doubles tennis players of all-time and holds the record for the most doubles wins in the Davis Cup. Paes won eight men's doubles and ten mixed doubles Grand Slam titles. He holds a career Grand Slam in men's doubles and mixed doubles making him one of only three men in the Open era to achieve this distinction and won the rare men's/mixed double at the 1999 Wimbledon Championships. Paes, together with Mahesh Bhupathi, were the first pair in Open era history to reach the men's doubles finals of all 4 Grand Slams in the same calendar year (1999).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As one of the greatest doubles tennis players of all-time, Leander Paes holds the record for the most doubles wins in the Davis Cup and has won eight men's doubles and ten mixed doubles Grand Slam titles. His achievements with Mahesh Bhupathi made them the first pair in Open era history to reach the men's doubles finals of all 4 Grand Slams in the same calendar year (1999).
